tasks.label: file-merge-coordination-issue
tasks.command: bd create 'Merge coordination: cleanup agent and merge conflict cleanup can launch simultaneously' -t bug -p 0 -d 'Merge coordination is not fully serialized. One agent process can launch a Cleanup Agent at the same time another agent launches a Merge Conflict Cleanup agent, causing concurrent access to the repo during merge operations. Both should be mutually exclusive with each other and with the merge lock.' --json

tasks.label: file-crash-followup-issues
tasks.command: bd create 'Orchestrator crash leaves no shutdown log entry' -t bug -p 0 -d 'When the orchestrator process is killed (hard crash or OOM), the log ends abruptly with no shutdown or completion message. The orchestrator should register a SIGTERM/SIGINT handler to flush a final log entry before dying, so crashes are distinguishable from clean exits.' --json && bd create 'Simultaneous worker commits may cause freeze/hang' -t bug -p 0 -d 'Multiple parallel workers committing at the same time (each running pre-commit hooks with full test suite) can cause resource contention or a deadlock. In a run with 4 workers, 2 workers were simultaneously in git commit at ~17:14 with initial_wait values of 300s and 30s. The orchestrator froze and was killed. Workers should serialize commits through a commit lock, similar to the existing merge lock.' --json
